question.problem:
Suppose we would like to find the minimum value of the function $f(x,y,z)=xy+{z}^{2}$ on the intersection of the surfaces ${z}^{2}+{x}^{2}=4$ and $x+2y=-2$ using the method of Lagrange multipliers. Then, the corresponding Lagrange multipliers $\lambda $ and $\mu $ satisfy the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}⟨y,\,x,\,2z⟩=\lambda ⟨\,\bbox[2pt,border:1pt solid black]{\phantom{AA}},\,0,\,2z⟩+\mu ⟨1,\,\bbox[2pt,border:1pt solid black]{\phantom{AA}},\,0⟩ \\ {z}^{2}+{x}^{2}=4 \\ x+2y=-2\end{aligned}
$$

From left to right, what are the missing expressions?
